description:
UnitySVC runs the official LibreTranslate image in a separate container for each enrollment, with its own HTTPS address. LibreTranslate is a self-hosted machine-translation server: text is translated on the instance itself with open translation models (Argos Translate), not sent to a third-party translation service. It offers a REST API (`/translate`, `/detect`, `/languages`) and a web translator, and the languages it loads are chosen when you enroll.

Enroll in the base channel, choose up to three language codes (the default is English and Spanish) and keep or replace the generated API key. The instance accepts only requests that carry that key, in the web translator as well as in the API. The language models are downloaded when the instance starts, so a new instance takes a short while to become ready, and they are downloaded again each time it starts. Nothing else is stored. See How to use this service for full setup and limitations.

You pay the selected channel's platform compute cost while the instance runs, including idle time. Labs adds no markup and receives no seller payout. See the upstream LibreTranslate documentation and issue tracker for software-specific help.

LIBRETRANSLATE_API_KEY.description: Generated for this enrollment; keep it or enter your own. Every request to the instance, in the web translator and in the API, must carry this key (the `api_key` field), or it is refused. Save it; it is also shown in the enrollment's instance details.

LT_LOAD_ONLY.description: Comma-separated language codes to load, at most three, for example `en,es` or `en,fr,de`. Each language adds a model download (about 200 MB per language pair direction) and memory; three languages were checked to fit this size. Models are downloaded when the instance starts.
